relation_to_our_case.reading: The prior art we surfaced concerns the QUALITY of the annotations. Our case concerns the SCOPE of the published claim against the published baseline. These are different defect classes. We do NOT conclude ours is new: our search recall is 0.33/0.00 and the word 'new' is prohibited without the scope that failed to find it.
